description: Change an ad squad's targeting: countries, age, gender, interests, device OS, include segments, or stop excluding segments. Everything not mentioned is kept; countries that stay in the list keep their regional geo entries. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

gender.description: MALE, FEMALE or leave empty for everyone.

include_segments.description: Ids of audiences to target. Get them from snap_list_segments.

interests.description: Replace interests with these ids (e.g. SLC_11); use snap_targeting_options to find ids

max_age.description: Oldest age, up to 50 (50 means 50 and over).

os_type.description: iOS or ANDROID, or leave empty for both.

name: snap_set_targeting
